import hashlib
import json
import sys
from pathlib import Path
sys.path.insert(0,'/private/tmp/sdkbench-product-conformance-20261121/src')
from sdkbench.candidates.applications import fixture
from sdkbench.p0 import Bundle
from sdkbench.p0.evaluators import routing

root = Path('/private/tmp/fq-sabre-trial-stream-20261122/docs/development/evidence')
index = json.loads((root/'sabre-trial-reuse-screen.json').read_text())
ops = {}
for entry in index['operation_files']:
    raw = (root/entry['name']).read_bytes()
    assert hashlib.sha256(raw).hexdigest() == entry['sha256']
    data = json.loads(raw)
    assert not ops.keys() & data.keys()
    for key,value in data.items():
        assert hashlib.sha256(json.dumps(value,separators=(',',':'),allow_nan=False).encode()).hexdigest() == key
    ops.update(data)
rows = index['rows']
bundle = Bundle(Path('/private/tmp/sdkbench-product-conformance-20261121/docs/implementation'))
accepted = 0
max_error = 0
for row in rows:
    width,family,topology = row['case']
    source = fixture(width,family,topology,index['manifest']['nonces'][row['nonce_index']])
    case = bundle.cases['ROUTE-GRID-08' if width == 8 else f'ROUTE-LINE-{width:02d}']
    for variant in row['variants'].values():
        p = variant['payload']
        variant['payload'] = {'operations': ops[p['operations_ref']], 'final_layout': p['final_layout'], 'compile_wall_seconds': p['compile_wall_seconds']}
        actual = routing(variant['payload'],source,None,case,0)
        assert actual == variant['metrics']
        assert p['final_layout'] == list(range(width))
        max_error = max(max_error,actual['max_semantic_error'])
        accepted += 1
for entry in index['original_files']:
    start,end = entry['row_range']
    raw = (json.dumps(rows[start:end],separators=(',',':'),allow_nan=False)+'\n').encode()
    assert hashlib.sha256(raw).hexdigest() == entry['sha256'] and len(raw) == entry['bytes']
for module in ('flagquantum','qiskit','cirq'):
    assert not any(name == module or name.startswith(module+'.') for name in sys.modules)
report = {'accepted': accepted, 'failures': 0, 'maximum_semantic_residual': max_error, 'SDK_imports': [], 'original_report_bytes_reconstructed': True, 'full_operator_acceptances': sum(row['case'][0] == 6 for row in rows)*3, 'three_probe_acceptances': sum(row['case'][0] != 6 for row in rows)*3, 'driver_source':Path(__file__).read_text()}
(root/'sabre-trial-reuse-replay.json').write_text(json.dumps(report,indent=2)+'\n')
print(json.dumps({k:v for k,v in report.items() if k!='driver_source'}))
